rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides a foundation for building AI agent systems with persistent memory and workflow integration, designed specifically for SaaS deployment and monetization. Built by Matthew Smith using Node.js, TypeScript, Express, and PostgreSQL with Prisma ORM, it offers core functionality for agent management, persistent memory storage per agent, user authentication with API key management, and n8n workflow integration through trigger endpoints. The implementation features Docker containerization for easy deployment, database migrations for schema management, and a RESTful API structure that supports multi-tenant SaaS applications, making it valuable for developers building AI employee systems that need to maintain context across sessions, integrate with existing workflow automation tools, and scale as commercial offerings.
